summary.text: Jaron Brandon is the Democratic candidate for California State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Alexandra Duarte in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a two-term Tuolumne County supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Jaron Brandon earned a high school diploma from Sonora Union High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Merced in 2015.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in a rural trailer park in Tuolumne County, was the first in his family to graduate from college, and worked in technology for several years before returning home.
Brandon said in the survey that, as a two-term Tuolumne County supervisor, he has brought investments in public safety, broadband, wildfire resilience and housing.
He said he is running on a platform called the Square Deal, aimed at making life more affordable for working families and supporting rural California.
